trial.question: How does the trial work?
trial.answer: Seven days of Plus for free and without a card — once per user and per Lesta account. You need a linked account. If a friend invited you, the trial is 14 days. It does not renew on its own: Plus simply switches off afterwards.

free.question: What stays free?
free.answer: All the essentials: profiles and stats of any player, marks and thresholds, tank tables, leaderboards, sessions, replays, clans, community, tools and the API. Plus sells our analytics, room and conveniences, not Lesta data.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: Payments open later: for now the trial and promo codes are available. YooKassa will take the payment — Three Marks never stores your card details and only receives a masked number for auto-renew.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Yes, any time: turn auto-renew off in your account with one click. Plus keeps working until the end of the paid period. Support handles partial refunds.

expiry.question: What happens when Plus ends?
expiry.answer: Nothing is deleted. Analytics go back to the free window, extra overlays are paused, and goals, accounts and replays over the limit stay viewable. Renew Plus and everything comes back at once.

noAds.question: Will there be ads?
noAds.answer: No — with or without a subscription.

data.question: Where does the data come from?
data.answer: Stats come from Lesta's public API and from our mod if you have it installed. Three Marks is a fan project not affiliated with Lesta. We never ask for your game password: sign-in is via Lesta ID only.

promo.question: How do I use a promo code?
promo.answer: A free-days code is redeemed in your account under «Subscription» — the days are added to your current period. A discount code is entered at checkout on this page.
